Benign neoplasm of cardiovascular structures; additional anatomical sites vary across subtypes.
Malignant neoplasm arising in the tongue, an oral cavity organ.
Calcium oxalate stones of the urinary tract; no specific systemic metabolic disorder is established for this umbrella.
Hereditary sensorimotor neuropathy; fixed pes cavus, talipes and scoliosis occur in 30-79%. Nystagmus reflects neurologic dysfunction.
